trainer/30458.htm.text: Blacksmith Poitan: Nice to meet you, traveler. I am the Blacksmith of this village. I just opened up for business after completing the workshop's remodeling a few days ago! So, what can I do for you?

links.text: Bestow special ability on a weapon
View information about the lord and tax rate

trainer/30458-4.htm.text: Blacksmith Poitan: Do you wish to remove the seal on your armor? Sealing or seal removal can be done quite easily here.

links.text: Release seal on B-grade gloves and boots.
Put seal back on B-grade gloves and boots.
Put seal back on A-grade armor.

trainer/30458-5.htm.text: Blacksmith Poitan: You can augment an item or remove augment here.

trainer/30458-noteach.htm.text: Blacksmith Poitan: Tsk tsk, I only teach Dwarven Fighters and Artisans. You need to pay more attention to your words. Good day now!

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30458-01.html.text: Blacksmith Poitan: Oh, you're a Kamael! I have so many questions for you, but... I'm very busy with Clayton's request right now... Would you mind coming back later?

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30458-02.html.text: Blacksmith Poitan: Oh, you're a Kamael! Tell me: What foods does your race eat? What gods do you worship? What powers do you possess? Any secret skills...?

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30458-04.html.text: Blacksmith Poitan: Ha! How interesting...you, a Kamael, running a Dark Elf's errands...

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30458-10.html.text: Blacksmith Poitan: Did you speak with my friend Holvas ? Not yet? Go see him now...

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30458-01.html.text: Blacksmith Poitan: The Book of Knowledge? Ha! That was sold long ago. Triff left it to cover his bar tab, but I didn't think he would pay it back so I sold it. It was a Sage who bought it. He was a very eager buyer and paid handsomely for it. If you want the book, talk to him. I have his name here,…
when: state STARTED; has items 2705; lacks items 2711,2715,2709

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30458-02.html.text: Blacksmith Poitan: I told you the book has already been sold to Elder Casian from the Wastelands ! Go to the Wastelands if you want the book!
when: state STARTED; has items 2705,2711,2715,2709; lacks items 2715,2709

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30458-03.html.text: Blacksmith Poitan: I guess Elder Casian gave you work to do. Well, nothing is free, my friend.

Q00363_SorrowfulSoundOfFlute/30458-01.ht.text: Blacksmith Poitan: Oh, Barbado. What would he want? Oh, I know! He mentioned recently that he didn't have anything to wear to a special event? Burp! Perhaps what he needs is a new outfit!

Q00363_SorrowfulSoundOfFlute/30458-02.ht.text: Blacksmith Poitan: Oh, Barbado. What would he want? Oh, I know! He mentioned recently that he wanted to learn a new instrument! Burp! Perhaps what he wants is a flute!

Q00363_SorrowfulSoundOfFlute/30458-03.ht.text: Blacksmith Poitan: Oh, Barbado. What would he want? Oh, I know! He likes nothing better than a cold glass of black beer after a performance!

Q00363_SorrowfulSoundOfFlute/30458-04.ht.text: Blacksmith Poitan: Ha ha ha.... I can't stop laughing! Ha ha ha...

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30458-03.html.text: Blacksmith Poitan: Please forgive my lack of manners -- I'm afraid I let my curiosity about your race get the better of me! But tell me, my new friend, how can I help you today? (Hand over the Enmity Crystal Core.)

links.text: I was sent by Magister Clayton, but...

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30458-05.html.text: Blacksmith Poitan: Ha! How interesting...you, a Kamael, running a Dark Elf's errands...

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30458-06.html.text: Blacksmith Poitan: (Talk about the Dark Elf Clayton and answer Poitan's questions.) Hmm... I see. Even before the seal on your island was removed and you began to appear on the mainland, we Dwarves were vaguely aware of your existence through various records and research left behind by beings who w…

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30458-07.html.text: Blacksmith Poitan: Sorry! The Giants, I mean -- sometimes I lapse into my native tongue, which is somewhat more...poetic. The Giants were a great race who lived long, long ago. Through their science, they become almost the equal of the gods themselves. Our Dwarven skills, as well as many of the mag…

links.text: I see. So where can I meet them?

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30458-08.html.text: Blacksmith Poitan: Alas, they can no longer be found in this world. Perhaps they became extinct or migrated to another part of the world or evolved into other beings... Truthfully, we don't know. We have only a handful of myths and historians' theories. Just speculations, mind you, but... There are…

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30458-09.html.text: Blacksmith Poitan: I heard that a Dwarven explorer discovered some records left by the Giants about your race at the Giants' Ruins. Unfortunately, both he and the records seem to have disappeared. Nobody knows if he is alive or dead... I heard this from my close friend Holvas , so if you're interes…

But remember, a higher price doesn't necessarily mean a better product. There are many excellent weapons that are reasonably priced. As I'm sure you know, capabilities added to your weapon don't int…

common/crafting_01.htm.text: [Create ingredient item] Our Blacksmith Guild creates items at a very reasonable price. You may entrust your precious materials to our Blacksmiths. They have a long-standing tradition of integrity. We will do our best to serve you. The creation of the ingredient for A-grade items is the pride of ou…

links.text: Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

common/augmentation_01.htm.text: Augmenting means give energy to weapons or accessories. Augmenting is simple, but it isn't always accurate. A few days ago, a mysterious ore called Life Stone, which has a very similar characteristic to Soul Crystals, was found in Black Anvil. If you bring this Life Stone and some other necessities…

links.text: Exchange Life Stone for augmenting accesorries.

common/augmentation_02.htm.text: You wish to remove the refined Life Stone? That's fine. But understand that this smelting method offers both improvement and potential penalties. It is difficult to restore the original weapon when removing the Life Stone. It requires a special chemical process and a special tool. It's also expensi…

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
